claims.statement: Editorial pitches to Spotify must be submitted before release day, and earlier is better (we suggest 3 to 4 weeks).
claims.howToCheck: In Spotify for Artists help, read 'Pitching music to playlist editors' and confirm the timing advice still matches.

claims.statement: A songwriter should register with only one PRO, never the same songs with two.
claims.howToCheck: Confirm with BMI or ASCAP guidance that a writer can only belong to one PRO at a time.
